legacy_evaluation_leakage.explanation_heartbleed_20_infiltration_3: Real CIC-IDS2017 contains 11 Heartbleed and 36 Infiltration flows across ~2.83M records, with ~80.3% BENIGN. However, this repository only contains the synthetically generated CICIDS2017_Benchmark_Sample.csv (15,000 rows: 50% BENIGN, 150 Heartbleed [1%], 300 Infiltration [2%]). Legacy evaluation.py sampled n=2000 randomly from all 15,000 rows instead of the held-out split, producing exact counts Heartbleed=20 and Infiltration=36 while leaking 869/2000 (43.45%) training rows.
